title: Shaped Recipe
description: A shaped crafting recipe for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Shaped recipes require ingredients to be placed in a specific pattern on the crafting grid.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this recipe file. Common versions include '1.12' and '1.20.10'.

minecraft:recipe_shaped.title: Shaped Recipe Definition
minecraft:recipe_shaped.description:
The shaped recipe definition container.

Properties:
• description ({ identifier })
• tags (string[])
• group (string)
• pattern (string[])
• key
• result ({ item, data, count })
• priority (int)
• assume_symmetry (boolean)
• ... and 1 more properties

description.title: Description
description.description:
The recipe description containing identifier.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for this recipe (e.g., 'minecraft:anvil').

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags that specify which crafting stations can use this recipe (e.g., 'crafting_table', 'stonecutter').

group.title: Group
group.description: An optional group identifier for recipe book organization.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: The crafting pattern as an array of strings. Each string represents a row, and each character maps to a key. Use space for empty slots.

key.title: Key
key.description:
Maps pattern characters to item definitions.

Properties:
• [A-Za-z#] ({ item, data, tag })

[A-Za-z#].title: Item Key
[A-Za-z#].description:
An item definition for a pattern character.

Properties:
• item (string)
• data (int)
• tag (string)

data.title: Data
data.description:
[DEPRECATED] The item data/aux value for items with variants.

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.20.0*

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: An item tag that matches multiple items (e.g., 'minecraft:planks').

defaultSnippets.label: Item Key
defaultSnippets.description: An item definition for a pattern character.

data.title: Data
data.description:

result.title: Result
result.description:
The crafting result.

Properties:
• item (string)
• data (int)
• count (int)

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Recipe priority for conflict resolution. Lower values have higher priority.

assume_symmetry.title: Assume Symmetry
assume_symmetry.description: If true, the recipe pattern can be mirrored horizontally.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.description:
Conditions that must be met to unlock this recipe in the recipe book.

Properties:
• item (string)
• context (string)

item.title: Item
item.description: The item that must be obtained to unlock this recipe.

context.title: Context
context.description: The context in which the recipe is unlocked (e.g., 'AlwaysUnlocked', 'PlayerInWater', 'PlayerHasManyItems', 'None').
